what: audit chain heads are anchored to a device-held HMAC key

design.mac: hmac-sha256(keystore key, idx|hash|anchored_at); the key is generated in AndroidKeyStore with purpose SIGN|VERIFY and digest SHA256 and is not exportable
design.append: every audit append anchors its own row
design.migration: rows written before the anchor table are anchored on first verification (ensureAnchors)

result: audit page reads 'chain intact across 14 events; 14 heads anchored to the device key'
honest_limits: this is device-key anchoring, not remote timestamping: someone who extracts or replaces the device key can still forge anchors
a truncated tail still verifies as a shorter chain
anchoring to a third party (or to an exported archive the user keeps elsewhere) would be the next step
bugs_found: first version exported the Keystore key with getEncoded(), which is null by design for non-exportable keys, so no anchors were ever written; signing now happens with the Key object
an install already at schema 13 never re-ran the backfill, so missing anchors are now created lazily during verification
